description: Tool to create a promotion code linked to an underlying coupon. Use when you need to generate customer-redeemable codes with optional restrictions.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for creating a promotion code.

active.description: Whether the promotion code is currently active. Defaults to true if not specified.
active.title: Active

code.description: The customer-facing code (alphanumeric only: a-z, A-Z, 0-9). Maximum 500 characters. Auto-generated if omitted. Must be unique across all active promotion codes.
code.title: Code

coupon.description: ID of the coupon that this promotion code will apply. This is required.
coupon.title: Coupon

customer.description: ID of the customer that this promotion code can be used by. If not set, the promotion code can be used by all customers.
customer.title: Customer

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp specifying when the promotion code will expire. Cannot exceed the coupon's redeems_by timestamp if specified.
expires_at.title: Expires At

max_redemptions.description: A positive integer specifying the number of times the promotion code can be redeemed. Cannot exceed the coupon's max_redemptions if set.
max_redemptions.title: Max Redemptions

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. Useful for storing additional information in a structured format.
metadata.title: Metadata

restrictions.description: Settings for restricting the promotion code's redemption.

minimum_amount.description: Minimum purchase amount required in the specified currency (in smallest currency unit).
minimum_amount.title: Minimum Amount

currency_options.description: Per-currency minimum purchase amounts (using ISO 4217 currency codes as keys).
currency_options.title: Currency Options

first_time_transaction.description: If true, the promotion code can only be redeemed by customers without any successful payments or invoices.
first_time_transaction.title: First Time Transaction

minimum_amount.description: Minimum purchase amount required to redeem the promotion code (in smallest currency unit).
minimum_amount.title: Minimum Amount

minimum_amount_currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the minimum_amount.
minimum_amount_currency.title: Minimum Amount Currency

restrictions.title: Restrictions
